svg.title: From joint-aware local prediction to stateful long-form composition
svg.desc: Native vector master. All labels are editable Times New Roman text. Waveforms, poses, and score snippets are schematic illustrations, not measurements or experimental results.

g.text: Candidates · bar units · style · acoustic cues
Step right; sweep the left arm
across the torso and settle low.
Widen the arm sweep; turn left
and finish with the arms low.
